'''March 2001 Terryville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Terryville, CT on 17 March 2001. [[Greg West]] won it. It is known from Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1924">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-3-17-mass-vs-ct-kashyyyk-beatdownd1924/ 3-17-mass-vs-ct-kashyyyk-beatdown], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-3-17-mass-vs-ct-kashyyyk-beatdownd1924/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Terryville, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Greg West]]
